name: zerodha-equity-futures-sell-10l-before-the-stt-change
describes: The same sell on Friday 2026-03-27: NSE's 1-3-2026 transaction charge plus the separate IPFT contribution at Rs 0.01 per crore, nil on this size (W-185); STT still 0.02%, because Finance Act 2026 s.159 takes effect on 30-3-2026.
